an8.72:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] saddho ca bhikkhave, bhikkhu hoti no ca sīlavā.
an8.72:1.4: kintāhaṃ saddho ca assaṃ sīlavā cāti.
an8.72:1.5: yato ca kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddho ca hoti, sīlavā ca,
an8.72:2.1: saddho ca bhikkhave, bhikkhu hoti sīlavā ca no ca bahussuto …pe…
an8.72:2.4: parisāvacaro ca hoti no ca visārado parisāya dhammaṃ deseti …pe…
an8.72:2.5: visārado ca dhammaṃ deseti no ca ye te santā vimokkhā atikkamma rūpe āruppā te kāyena phusitvā viharati, …pe…
an8.72:2.6: ye te santā vimokkhā atikkamma rūpe āruppā te kāyena phusitvā viharati no ca āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭhevadhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an8.72:2.9: kintāhaṃ saddho ca assaṃ sīlavā ca bahussuto ca dhammakathiko ca parisāvacaro ca visārado ca parisāya dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ, ye te santā vimokkhā atikkamma rūpe āruppā, te kāyena phusitvā vihareyyaṃ …pe… āsavānaṃ khayā …pe… sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyanti.
an8.72:3.1: yato ca kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddho ca hoti sīlavā ca bahussuto ca dhammakathiko ca parisāvacaro ca visārado ca parisāya dhammaṃ deseti, ye te santā vimokkhā atikkamma rūpe āruppā te kāyena phusitvā viharati āsavānaṃ khayā …pe… sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati,
an8.72:3.3: imehi kho bhikkhave, aṭṭhahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu samantapāsādiko ca hoti sabbākāra paripūro cāti.
